Những tiếng gầm rú hòa vào nhau

note: Golden fixture cho ValvrareTeam (valvrareteam.net, site VN Light Novel Vietsub, Next.js + API JSON). Truyen mau 1: Danmachi - Sword Oratoria — Fujino Omori, Ongoing, 4 chuong (Hinh minh hoa + Chuong mo dau: BINH MINH NOI ME CUNG + Chuong 1: LOKI FAMILIA); ch. mo dau 135 doan DOM, mo dau 'Nhung tieng gam ru hoa vao nhau, doi len thanh mot buc tuong am thanh...'; chuong Hinh minh hoa 21 anh. Truyen mau 2: Toi da sang the gioi khac, nhung the gioi nay ghet toi! — Hinko, Ongoing, 20 chuong. Truyen mau 3: Trong Sinh Tu Tien Doi Thuong — 330 chuong; ch.301 (balance 167) doc du 198 doan, mo dau 'Hom nay la ngay 24 thang 4, Thu Nam.'. API /api/novels BO QUA tham so genre/status (kiem chung 2026-11-14) nen loc the loai/trang thai lam phia client (limit=100, quet tuan tu). The loai: 54 muc that tu API tru Incest/Netorare (quy tac nha, khong dua NSFW vao catalog chung). Muc luc day du 1 lan qua API detail (khong phan trang). Chuong doc qua div.chapter-content SSR (khong dung RSC payload). Tim kiem /api/novels/search?title= (khong phan trang). Binh luan: truong noi dung la 'text' (HTML), khong phai 'content'.
